purpose: Four scoped historical review cases for a wiring comparison, not a representative quality benchmark.

cases.head: d6b892a2e84b7895d4047ecfa392691d263b12d0
cases.request: Review visible review sessions, saved completion and restoration behavior.

criteria.statement: A previously delivered completion must not be delivered again when its completed review is restored under a supported SDK.

cases.head: c21a3ec1d62c497d7dfeca1b6ee867a6adb3d1ab
cases.request: Move review worker dispatch back to the configured team batch; preserve bounded one-batch completion and ownership of partial-lane work.

criteria.statement: Raw unconfigured wave dispatch is intentionally replaced by the configured team tools and one all-settled batch. Review whether the replacement meets that contract.

cases.head: 5366abb784e11fb9c1f2a9dc641fb1ff31d4c270
cases.request: Review helper report finalization and pending-cleanup status updates, including how final progress is displayed.

criteria.statement: An unchanged final progress message remains readable across status refreshes while matching cleanup is pending.

cases.head: 4b1e148bd62d215294d0f8044d1bf5bf334f42aa
cases.request: Review preservation of the invoking session's supported thinking level. Worker-tier configuration remains separate; external completion subscriptions are outside this case's scored scope.

criteria.statement: The coordinator preserves supported effective high/xhigh thinking and does not silently downgrade unsupported requests. Configured worker tiers are unchanged.
